result.title: On the Convergence of Semi-Gradient TD: A Mean Field Perspective
result.summary: Semi-gradient temporal-difference learning is a core algorithmic component of reinforcement learning, but bootstrapping with function approximation generally induces a non-conservative vector field and can lead to instability. We analyze this effect for two-layer neural networks in the mean-field regime and identify a simple stability mechanism in which entropy-induced relaxation dominates the sensitivity of the moving bootstrap target. Under this condition, we prove exponential convergence to a unique fixed point and quantify its bias relative to the unregularized Bellman solution. We also show that the same mechanism extends to entropy-regularized off-policy control through soft Q-learning.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文在 mean-field 框架下分析两层神经网络中 semi-gradient TD 的稳定性，指出熵诱导的松弛可压过 bootstrap 目标敏感性，从而证明指数收敛到唯一不动点并量化其相对 Bellman 解的偏差，并推广到 soft Q-learning。
AI.relevance_reason: 其关于迭代更新动力学的不动点存在性、收敛条件与正则化偏差的分析思路，可能可供核查 loop／迭代式 latent 推理状态的稳定性与停止判据，但与本主线无直接关联，属远域借鉴线索。
